{{Quote|We're being sent to my mother's on Talivar.|Flix, on his and Orka's plans to escape the First Order|audio=Talivar-NoEscapePart1.flac|<ref name="No Escape 1" />}}
'''Talivar''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="No Escape 1" /> located within the [[Talivar system]]<ref name="Appendix" /> of the [[Chorlian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AppendixCorr" /> Talivar, along with the rest of the Talivar system, was located within grid square S-4 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. the astronomical object was where the [[Flix's mother|mother]] of the [[Gozzo]] [[Flix]] had a [[Flix's mother's home|home]].<ref name="No Escape 1" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY">{{ResistanceDate|1|20}}</ref> after the [[First Order]] [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupied]] the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''<ref name="No Escape 1" /> on the [[planet]] [[Castilon]],<ref name="Ace">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 1}}</ref> business partners Flix and [[Orka]] attempted to escape the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]] to Flix's [[Parent|mother's]] home. They arranged for the [[First Order delivery service]] to ship themselves,<ref name="No Escape 1" /> their pet<ref name="Bitey">{{Databank|bitey|Bitey}}</ref> [[gorg]] [[Bitey]], and the [[DUM-series pit droid|pit droid]] [[G-LN]] to Talivar inside a large crate<ref name="No Escape 1" /> labeled "TALIVAR organic material."<ref name="Bucket's List No Escape">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-no-escape-part-1-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 8 Fun Facts from "No Escape: Part 1" - ''Star Wars Resistance''|date=2019-03-11}}</ref> However, the [[Mission to contact the Resistance|sinking]] of the ''Colossus'' prevented that plan from coming to fruition.<ref name="No Escape 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talivar was first mentioned in "[[No Escape: Part 1]],"<ref name="No Escape 1" /> the twentieth episode of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|season one]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',<ref name="DVD">''[[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One]]''</ref> which aired on [[March 10]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
